title: Pan-Fried Sea Bass with Tomato and Artichoke Sauce
blurb: Tender sea bass fillets served with a Mediterranean sauce of cherry tomatoes, artichoke hearts and onion
steps: Peel and finely chop the onion and garlic. Halve the cherry tomatoes and drain and quarter the artichoke hearts.
Season the sea bass fillets on both sides with salt and pepper.

Heat two tablespoons of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the sea bass skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook for another 2 minutes until just cooked through. Remove to a warm plate.
Add the remaining olive oil to the same pan, then cook the onion and garlic over medium heat for 2 minutes until softened.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they start to break down, then add the white wine and let it bubble for a minute.
Stir in the artichoke hearts and cook for another 2 minutes to heat through. Season the sauce with salt and pepper.
Return the sea bass to the pan to warm through briefly, then serve with the sauce spooned over.
